release-mgr: FYI: short release-freeze window + updated hotpatch rules for next release train. Please read & flag exceptions by EOD Tue.

- Freeze window: Thu 2025-07-10 00:00 -> Fri 2025-07-11 12:00 UTC. No normal deploys.
- Emergency hotpatches allowed only for SEV1/SEV2 and require: release owner sign-off + oncall ack + a linked rollback PR.
- During freeze, canary-only smoke checks allowed via shadow deploys (no traffic ramp).
- We'll still run automated infra patches for critical CVEs (ops-bot will announce).

nina: Quick Q: does the freeze apply to Dedicated infra config rollouts?

release-mgr: Yes, applies org-wide. Config-only changes that are non-customer-facing can be scheduled but need an exception ticket with approvers.

sahil: I'll sync with platform team, but note that scheduled autoscaler tuning job runs Fri morning — do we want to postpone?

jake: Ops-bot posted earlier that kernel patch will be in that same window. If it's critical we should allow a maintenance slot.

ops-bot: maintenance-bot: Critical kernel patch CVE-2025-1234 scheduled 2025-07-10 02:00-03:00 UTC. Marked as exception=true by security.

release-mgr: Thanks. Treat security-exempt maintenance as approved; please still follow the hotpatch checklist.

---HOTPATCH CHECKLIST---
1) Create issue: release-exception/<team>-<short> and tag approvers.
2) Post rollback PR link in the issue before approval.
3) Acquire release owner + oncall sign-off in thread.
4) Run and paste smoke-test output `smoke-test --hotpatch --timeout 180s`.
5) After deploy, run postmortem template if any customer impact.

product-comm: Heads up — we'll prepare a short internal blurb for CS and account teams explaining the freeze. No public notice required unless SLA changes.

nina: Noted. I'll update the release calendar and block the schedule in shared calendar.

sahil: Also rolling up weekly changelog:
- runtime: improved batching shim, reduces 95p latency for small prompts ~8%.
- infra: autoscaler bugfix for delayed scale-down during low-load.
- monitoring: added canary error-rate detector with 0.5% threshold.
- docs: new deploy quiet-mode guidance (link: https://redwood.internal/docs/deploy-quiet-mode).

release-mgr: Thanks for the changelog summary. One operational note: canary hold rule is set to pause rollouts when error-rate >= 0.5% for 5m; owners should verify their canary dashboards before starting.

oncall: I'll publish alert rule diffs to #eng-infra today. Also setting an oncall shadow for the freeze window.

jake: For teams needing emergency fast-tracking of a customer hotfix (SEV2 brownout), follow the hotpatch checklist and escalate to me if oncall is unavailable.

release-mgr: We'll run a 20-minute pre-freeze readiness sync Wed 18:00 UTC to answer last-minute items. Calendar invite sent.

product-comm: I'll draft a short FAQ for internal teams about what constitutes an emergency hotpatch and share it in #eng-releases.

release-mgr: TL;DR: freeze Thu 00:00->Fri 12:00 UTC, hotpatches allowed only with sign-off+rollback+smoke-test, security maintenance exempt but follow checklist. Comment exceptions by EOD Tue.
